parsed.summary: The patch addresses the two-digit year issue but may introduce unexpected behavior due to the dynamic calculation of the century.

issues.description: The patch dynamically calculates the century based on the current year, which could lead to unexpected behavior if the code is run in a different time zone or if the system clock is not set correctly.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of the updated logic, which could lead to regressions in the future.
